title: Guarded Canary Scoped Enablement Executor Implementation Result
claim: FP-MCP-316 was implemented in the MCP bridge by extending forgepilot_apply_guarded_canary_next_gate to support the sequencer-selected scoped enablement preview/create gate only, while preserving the stop-before-runner-start boundary.
summary: The MCP bridge implementation on branch feature/oauth-auth0 added one executor branch for forgepilot_preview_operator_local_scoped_execution_enablement_review_manifest. The branch builds typed scoped enablement preview/create arguments from sequencer output, previews the scoped enablement review manifest, optionally applies the follow-on scoped enablement creation when applyPreviewFollowOn is true and preview has no reasons, and reports PREVIEW_AND_CREATE_SCOPED_ENABLEMENT boundary fields. No runner-start path, approval consumption, OpenCode start, or canary execution path was added.
caveats: The running MCP service may need to be rebuilt/restarted before the new executor branch is live.
This implementation result records code and verification only; it does not create a fresh approval, clearance, or scoped enablement.
A live FP-MCP-316 functional test still requires fresh approval, fresh clearance, fresh runner capability observation, and then invoking only forgepilot_apply_guarded_canary_next_gate.
boundaries: No runner start endpoint contact was implemented or performed.
No approval consumption was implemented or performed.
No OpenCode start was implemented or performed.
No canary execution was implemented or performed.
Adjacent manual enablement tools remain outside the default narrowed guarded surface; the executor routes through the sequencer-selected gate.
